hero.title: Cross-functional cybersecurity as a service (CSaaS)
hero.subtitle: Veriscudo delivers end-to-end protection for your organization: from risk governance and regulatory compliance to active defense, digital forensics, and offensive operations, all as a managed service.

intro.title: Cybersecurity that adapts to your organization
intro.subtitle: The CSaaS model (Cross-functional Cybersecurity as a Service) gives organizations access to enterprise-grade security capabilities, paying only for what they need, without the complexity of maintaining an in-house team.

items.title: No infrastructure investment
items.description: Access state-of-the-art tools and experts with no capital investment in equipment or licenses.

items.title: Scales as you grow
items.description: The service grows with you: adjust the level of protection to your organization's size and risk profile.

items.title: Specialized experts
items.description: Your organization gains access to a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity analysts and specialists without having to hire them.

items.title: Continuous 24/7 coverage
items.description: Around-the-clock monitoring and response to detect and neutralize threats in real time, without interruptions.

services.title: Protection at every layer of your organization
services.subtitle: Veriscudo structures its services into six categories covering the full cycle of enterprise cybersecurity.

categories.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
content: Security posture assessment (CIS Controls, NIST CSF, ISO 27000)
ICT asset inventory and cyber-risk matrix (BIA)
Risk analysis and business impact assessment
Strategic Information Security Plan (SISP) and action plans
Ongoing security incident management
Security policies based on ISO 27002:2022
Security program maturity assessments
Training and awareness: digital hygiene, executive and technical training, DevSecOps

categories.title: Monitoring, Detection & Response
content: SOCaaS — Security Operations Center as a Service with 24/7 coverage
SIEMaaS — Real-time security information and event management
EDRaaS — Advanced endpoint detection and response
Threat Intelligence — Threat intelligence contextualized for your industry
Threat Hunting — Proactive hunting for latent threats in your infrastructure

categories.title: Cyber Defense / Blue Team
content: Protection for corporate users, endpoints, and servers
Email protection against phishing, spoofing, and malware
Identity management and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
Data encryption at rest and in transit
Network traffic analysis and intrusion detection (IDS/IPS)
Protection for web applications and APIs
Managed XDR: XDR, EDR, NGFW, Email Security, DNS Security, SWG, and SIEM, integrated

categories.title: Digital Forensics (DFIR)
content: Collection and preservation of digital evidence with chain of custody
Forensic analysis of security incidents
Containment and eradication of active threats
Expert reports for legal or regulatory use

categories.title: Offensive Operations / Red Team
content: Continuous vulnerability management and remediation
Perimeter pentesting: networks, systems, and infrastructure
Web and mobile application pentesting
Social engineering: phishing, vishing, and targeted attack simulations
Wireless network security testing
Adversary simulation and emulation (Adversary Simulation)

categories.title: Cybersecurity e-Learning
content: Virtual learning platforms (LMS) for the whole organization
Custom cybersecurity content development
Attendance tracking and automatic certificate issuance
Online course hosting and management
Synchronous, asynchronous, and in-person training
Organization-wide awareness and security culture programs

cta.subtitle: Request a free security assessment and find out where you stand against cyber threats today.
